mapper.select: SELECT sender_id, count(*) AS message_count, coalesce(sum(char_length(content)), 0) AS char_count, min(created_at) AS first_at, max(created_at) AS last_at FROM chat_message WHERE GROUP BY sender_id ORDER BY message_count DESC, sender_id
SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS day, count(*) AS message_count FROM chat_message WHERE GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
SELECT extract(hour FROM (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'))::int AS hour_of_day, count(*) AS message_count FROM chat_message WHERE GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day

WITH filtered AS ( SELECT sender_id, content, created_at, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY created_at, id) AS rn, count(*) OVER () AS total FROM chat_message WHERE ) SELECT sender_id, content, created_at FROM filtered WHERE total <= #{limit} OR (rn - 1) % GREATEST(ceil(total::numeric / #{limit})::int, 1) = 0 ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT conversation_id FROM chat_message WHERE role = 'user' AND sender_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY conversation_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC
